rationale: Christine and Zee are both building in healthcare with complementary focuses: Christine's work on healthcare data and interoperability at Lattice Health creates infrastructure that AI-native products like Clara (Zee's YC-backed AI doctor startup) depend on to operate effectively. As a product designer and co-founder, Zee brings hands-on experience shipping in healthcare AI, while Christine's data platform expertise could unlock new capabilities for Clara's product roadmap.
intro_message: Christine Park, meet Zee — you're both tackling healthcare from different angles (data infrastructure vs. AI-native products) and could explore how Lattice Health and Clara might create value together.
